audited_source_corrections.action: Replaced both references to the fixed f'(c) as the object that changes when beta approaches zero with the varying difference quotient.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source says the value of f'(c) tends to the gradient and then describes the trend of f'(c) as beta approaches zero. For a fixed c, f'(c) does not vary with beta, and it has not yet been defined by this account.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: மாறிவரும் வித்தியாச ஈவின் மதிப்பே சாய்வை அணுகுவதாகவும் அதன் நெருங்கும் போக்கையே ஆராய்வதாகவும் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining f'(c) as though it were beta-dependent would misstate the limit construction.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The preceding section gives the varying quotient (f(c+beta)-f(c))/beta; its limit, when it exists, defines f'(c).
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the varying difference quotient, rather than the already fixed f'(c), the object whose beta-to-zero trend is intended?

audited_source_corrections.action: Added 0 < |x-c| to the epsilon-delta antecedent and explained that g need not be defined at c.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source's limit formula requires the implication even at x=c. That would force g(c)=ell when g is defined, describing continuity at c rather than an ordinary limit, and would exclude functions undefined at c.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: சாதாரண எல்லைக்கு உரிய துளையிடப்பட்ட அண்மையை 0 < |x-c| < delta என எழுதுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the unpunctured formula and calling it a limit would conflate limit with continuity at the point.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The section later defines continuity separately by f(c)=lim f(x), which requires the limit itself to be independent of the value at c.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Should the quantified implication require 0 < |x-c| < delta to represent the ordinary limit being described?
